prefer_subagents_for_token_heavy_work.title: Prefer subagents for token-heavy work
prefer_subagents_for_token_heavy_work.content: Keep the root session compact by delegating aggressively. For any task with independent or context-heavy work—repo/file exploration, web/background research, log/test triage, API/docs review, multiple implementation options, or parallel review—spawn one or more subagents early instead of loading all context in the parent. Give each child a narrow prompt, ask for a concise reply or artifact path, and let the parent orchestrate, decide, perform minimal edits, and answer. If two or more independent investigations are plausible, prefer subagents by default. Avoid reading large files/logs/pages in the parent when a child can summarize exact findings. Delete direct children when no longer needed.
